lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The executed critical path passed Dynamic Type, contrast, hit-region, element-description, and evidence-before-control ordering checks, but this artifact contains no human VoiceOver spoken-order transcript for source inspection, fact decisions, action preview, result, or recovery.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-09-03-system-e2e-agent-review/ios/results/iphone-se-ax5-summary.json records 8/8 passing UI journeys, including testAX5DarkModeCriticalContentRemainsReachable() and testAccessibilityOrderPlacesEvidenceBeforeFactDecision(); docs/evaluations/2026-09-03-system-e2e-agent-review/ios/ios-run-summary.md explicitly records VoiceOver as not run.
findings.user_impact: The native hierarchy is promising, but a screen-reader user may still encounter duplicate speech, misleading state values, or an order that automated element checks do not expose.
findings.recommendation: Record a VoiceOver traversal of import/source inspection, identity/context, each fact decision, action preview, truthful receipt, and retry/recovery on the same frozen build.
findings.verification: VoiceOver announces identity, context, provenance, proposed versus confirmed state, exact action effect, no-external-change receipt, and retry in a logical order with meaningful names, values, and hints and no duplicate controls.

strengths: The two baseline medium layout findings are resolved in direct post-change evidence. On iPhone SE in Simplified Chinese, AX5, dark appearance, and Reduce Motion, Ask now keeps provenance reachable and allows the full final sentence to be swiped above the fixed composer; docs/evaluations/2026-09-03-system-e2e-agent-review/ios/results/postchange-se-ax5-final-summary.json records 3/3 passing targeted journeys and ios/screenshots/postchange-se-ax5/final/062462B8-A787-4AAF-9717-5F4BC61A9C01.png shows the final punctuation above the composer.

Today now presents the complete `Leila Hartmann · Interview` and `Chief Product Officer search · Singapore time` without ellipses, and People presents Nia Williams's complete `Candidate · Independent board director search` on both iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone SE. Direct evidence is in ios/screenshots/postchange-iphone17/today/D0B49631-1963-4360-841D-E57C0462AE09.png, ios/screenshots/postchange-iphone17/people/9C301591-273C-4206-8901-A4993985C843.png, and ios/screenshots/postchange-se-ax5/final/1A9BE6AF-C4DE-475B-B7D8-03784AD44730.png; the post-change default result summaries record 3/3 targeted Today/People tests passing.
The iPhone 17 Pro journey keeps exact evidence, four independent fact decisions, a separate action preview, and the no-external-change outcome visually and behaviorally distinct.

Agent is a sparse, understandable control plane: Memory is visibly scoped, action permissions require approval, and Sources explains that a LinkedIn profile reference grants neither account access nor background sync.

The combined iPhone SE Simplified Chinese, AX5, dark-mode, and Reduce Motion run kept Today, Agent, Sources, Sessions, People, Ask, Text Signal, Audio Signal, evidence review, and recovery controls hittable.

Synthetic cancellation, failure, unrelated-image, background interruption, queued-capture recovery, and local receipt journeys completed without false external success; the deterministic native suite also passed 266/266 state and recovery tests.
missing_evidence: The coordinated canonical backend was unavailable, so this run did not directly execute Text Signal sync/readback, screenshot identity resolution plus compiled-Wiki receipt, canonical Proposal confirmation, owned-action completion, or response-loss reconciliation against the frozen backend.

No physical iPhone, VoiceOver spoken traversal, Switch Control, Full Keyboard Access, landscape, oldest deployment target, RTL, pseudo-localization expansion, increased contrast, reduce transparency, Low Power Mode, or measured latency run was collected.

No Photos limited/denied/revoked permission path, Contacts/Calendar/notifications denial or revocation, or successful/failed real destination write was run; consequential external writes were intentionally outside authorization.
The localization gate passed but still reported 164 transitional inline bilingual calls and 209 raw SwiftUI literals, so it is not proof of every-screen localization completeness.
